label: Changing commercial-bank aggregate in the Czech lands
definition: Active joint-stock banks in Bohemia, Moravia and Silesia in the League source, with changing membership. Headquarters/reporting coverage does not prove domestic-only branch assets.
exclusions_and_limits: Separate eastern joint-stock institutions, ordinary savings banks, cooperative credit associations and provincial banks are outside this group. Joint-stock savings/cooperative central institutions may belong. No fixed membership inferred from equal counts.

label: Reported commercial-bank income population
definition: Annual profit-and-loss reporting population. Its published count is 22 in 1936 while the balance-sheet count is 23.
exclusions_and_limits: Matching published counts elsewhere does not prove identical members. Income/end-assets ratios suppress the known 1936 mismatch.

label: Fourteen named handbook banks
definition: Retrospective cohort of Czech-lands-headquartered commercial/deposit-credit joint-stock banks with complete tables in the selected 1938 handbook chapters.
exclusions_and_limits: Handbook availability sample; not a random sample or failure panel. All fourteen map to the 1929 national roster; later League membership remains unmatched. Sporobanka changes mandate in 1937.

label: National Bank of Czechoslovakia
definition: Separate central-bank balance-sheet context from the League.
exclusions_and_limits: Not added to commercial-bank totals; loans to banks cannot be fully reconciled to commercial-bank creditor categories.

label: National twenty-two-bank roster
definition: The twenty-two named joint-stock institutions in national table X5, printed page 259.
exclusions_and_limits: A dated roster, not proof of later League membership. Footprint shares use numerator and denominator from this same source year.

label: Czechoslovak price context
coverage: 1919-1938 display grid; actual CPI 1923-1938, WPI extract 1929-1938
definition: Separate CPI and WPI context, with source-specific bases and timing.
exclusions_and_limits: Not prices specific to the bank sample. CPI1919-1922 is unavailable; WPI1929/1938 incomplete; no annual-mean infilling.
